title: automate-intermediate-ca-kms-derived-key-rotation-and-helm-upgrade-hooks
author: Elena Park
description: Motivation: enable safe, auditable rotation of intermediate CA certificates for Private deployments and integrate a KMS-derived key wrapping path so installations with HSMs can derive ephemeral wrapping keys without storing raw private keys. This change adds a Terraform module to provision a Vault PKI intermediate, Helm chart hooks to perform in-cluster signing and seamless secret handoff, a small operator script for controlled rotation during upgrades, and an explicit rollback path in the installer. Goals: minimize downtime for active clusters, provide auditability for cert rotations, support HSM-backed key derivation (KMS-derived KEK) and fall back to sealed-secrets when HSM is not present, and provide clear upgrade/rollback steps for on-prem customers. Action items completed: Terraform module for pki_intermediate with stateful rotation schedule; Helm post-upgrade hook that calls the operator in a leader-election-safe way; installer changes to coordinate canary rollouts of new intermediate CA and to wait for kubelets to pick up new certs; sealed-secrets integration for non-Vault installs; scripted failure injection for testing rollbacks in CI. Migration notes: default behavior is no-op for existing installs unless the customer opts into "managed-intermediate-rotation" in values.yaml; operators should read docs/upgrade-ca-rotation.md for step-by-step. Security notes: private keys are never written to installer state; when HSM is available we derive ephemeral KEKs via KMS-derive API and perform envelope encryption; audit logging hooks added to Vault and installer telemetry to record rotation events. Related: closes ENG-3145 and tracks SUP-4421. Checklist: ensure unit/integration tests pass; verify upgrade/rollback on a v1.2 cluster; notify SRE runbook owners; stage rollout behind a feature flag.

diff_snippets:
--- helm/redwood-private/templates/post-upgrade-pki-hook.yaml
+++ helm/redwood-private/templates/post-upgrade-pki-hook.yaml
@@
 apiVersion: batch/v1
 kind: Job
 metadata:
-  name: rotate-pki-hook
+  name: rotate-pki-hook
   annotations:
     "helm.sh/hook": post-upgrade
     "helm.sh/hook-weight": "0"
@@
 spec:
-  template:
-    spec:
-      containers:
-      - name: rotate
-        image: {{ .Values.images.installer }}
+  template:
+    spec:
+      containers:
+      - name: rotate
+        image: {{ .Values.images.installer }}
         command: ["/bin/rotate-ca.sh", "--mode=canary"]

--- terraform/modules/pki/main.tf
+++ terraform/modules/pki/main.tf
@@
 resource "vault_pki_secret_backend_intermediate_cert" "intermediate" {
-  backend = local.pki_path
-  pem_bundle = tls_self_signed_cert.example.cert_pem
+  backend = var.pki_backend_path
+  pem_bundle = local.issued_intermediate_pem
   ttl = var.intermediate_ttl
 }

release_notes: Added opt-in managed intermediate CA rotation for Private deployments; new Terraform module 'pki' to manage intermediate lifecycle; Helm post-upgrade hook to perform controlled handoff; KMS-derived KEK support for HSM-backed installs; documented upgrade and rollback procedures in docs/upgrade-ca-rotation.md. No breaking changes by default; feature disabled unless enabled in values.yaml.
notes_for_customers: This functionality is opt-in by default. To enable automated intermediate rotation, set values.privateInstaller.managedIntermediateRotation.enabled=true and ensure your Vault/KMS credentials are provided. For HSM customers, configure hsm.enabled=true and set kms.masterKeyId. Follow docs/upgrade-ca-rotation.md for a staged rollout and rollback instructions.
changelog_entry: 2024-06-04 - private-installer: opt-in intermediate CA rotation + KMS-derived KEK support (ENG-3145)
testing_instructions: 1) Deploy a test on-prem cluster with the example feature-toggle.yaml. 2) Enable managed-intermediate-rotation in values.yaml and run helm upgrade. 3) Observe rotation job post-upgrade and verify new intermediate is signed and published. 4) Run the provided e2e rotation_scenarios to simulate node restarts and verify no downtime. 5) Test rollback by running installer/upgrade/rollback.sh and confirming previous CA is restored.
security_considerations: Private keys are not stored in installer state. When hsm.enabled is true, KEKs are derived via KMS-derive API and used for envelope encryption; the plaintext key material is never persisted. Audit events for rotation are emitted to Vault audit-log and installer telemetry. Customers running sealed-secrets-only flows should expect a manual rotation step; see sealed-secrets/integration/README.md for details.
